title: Lighthouse Beach RV Resort

services.name: Cottage Rentals
services.desc: COTTAGES: 2 Bedrooms: Sleeps 5 people. One Queen-size bed, Bunk Room with 1 Full size and 1 twin size bunk, two TV’s with Roku Express, A/C and heat, Full size kitchen with full size appliances and bathroom with full size shower and a dinette table with 4 chairs. Cottage has a drip coffee maker, toaster, pots and pans and limited cooking utensils. Includes plates, cups and eating utensils. We also provide toilet paper, paper towels, dawn dish soap, a dish cloth, and coffee filters. YOU MUST BRING YOUR OWN LINENS, PILLOWS, BLANKETS, TOWELS AND WASHCLOTHS. Security deposit: $250.00 - CREDIT CARD The deposit covers cottage key & damage. Pet Friendly Cottages - Dogs Only: Four of our rental

services.name: Positioned For Fishing
services.desc: Whether you like to Crab, Fish or Clam, your possibilities abound at Lighthouse Beach RV Resort. Crab or fish from our own pier or launch your boat from our boat ramp to fish in Rehoboth Bay, or from the nearby public boat ramp to fish on the Indian
